option_relations.rationale: The description of a solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone extending along the course of the sciatic nerve into the left ischial groove, with characteristics of peripheral rim enhancement and arising from the sciatic nerve, matches the characteristics of a schwannoma, which is equivalent to Sciatic Schwannoma (B2.3).
Neurofibroma is a broader class of nerve sheath tumors, and schwannoma, which is equivalent to Sciatic Schwannoma (B2.3), is a subtype of neurofibroma.
